subject: asymmetric block jester
requested_medium: terrazzo and matte aluminum art toy
art_direction: 不对称积木偶用水磨石与磨砂铝组合，一高一低耳片，三色几何脸很淡定。
composition: one original central subject with a clear silhouette and circular-crop safe focal point
creative_direction: Design an abstract block jester from one rounded terrazzo body, two unequal ear-like tabs, and short matte-aluminum limbs. The face is a tiny arrangement of incised geometric marks, not large plastic eyes. Keep the body tilted a little while the feet stay planted, giving it a deadpan presence. Terrazzo chips should be sparse and large enough to read; use cream stone, teal, and terracotta fragments. Place the object against pale gray, with one broad studio shadow. Avoid hats, circus props, text, and a familiar designer-toy silhouette. Square 1024x1024. Keep the complete central silhouette within a circular crop, occupying about 70% of the canvas. Original design; no lettering, logos, or watermark.
style_inspiration: Entirely original text-only concept, no IP characters, copied artwork, celebrity likeness or named artist imitation.
visual_review: passed: compressed preview inspected for distinct original concept, appealing silhouette and expression, requested medium, coherent shape/anatomy, clean visual hierarchy, no text or watermark
